desc: Get rid of your felt pad and greasy beach towels and treat your 1911 with the respect it deserves. The 1911 Smart Mat was designed to be the ultimate cleaning mat for your favorite pistol. This 19" x 16" padded mat is large enough to handle a field-stripped 1911 and includes an attached parts tray to hold your pins, bushing, barrel and springs so they are always safely within reach. The oil-resistant surface has printed directions on how to disassemble your 1911 so you can properly clean your gun without ruining the kitchen table.
